GPU NanoChat sessions run the whole model on the Vortex SimX simulator (session backend simx, runs under build/student-mini/native-gpu/), not on the GPU RTL or the routed netlist; CPU sessions run entirely on the VexRiscv RTL (backend vexriscv-rtl). Tokens are compared token-exact against the PTQ reference. The GPU P1/P2/P3 records (1000) ran on the mapped GPU RTL with the physical command/memory adapters (backend vortex-rtlsim-mapped-core-fault-adapters).

GPU full-chip closure took three iterations (build/student-mini/explore/NOTES.md, 2026-10-14). Iteration 1 (top 8c8daf99 + clean blocks LL 1161c416, LR e9f0cde5, UL 940bd553, UR 189841ed): full-chip STA HOLD, setup -0.589 ns (rst_ni -> UL reset trunk; LR/LL half-cycle SRAM paths), hold -0.184 ns (LL -> UL), caused by the top clock tree driving three block clk_i pins over ~1 mm of top wire (slow, rise/fall-asymmetric edges, UL clock 0.35 ns later than LL). Iteration 2: a clock buffer within 3 um of every block clk_i (integration/student-mini/gpu_top_clock_pin_buffers.tcl as POST_CTS_TCL, plus CTS_ARGS, written by scripts/prepare_student_mini_gpu_top.py) -> STA HOLD -0.854 ns (rst_ni -> UL, LL <-> LR muldiv crossing); then a chip-timing-context ECO of UL and LR: scripts/derive_student_mini_gpu_block_context.py with integration/student-mini/gpu_block_context.tcl writes per-block SDC overlays from the assembled chip, and scripts/run_student_mini_platform_physical_ctx.py (derived from the unchanged base runner by scripts/make_student_mini_context_eco_tools.py) repaired UL (efb4ed2e, from 940bd553) and LR (454495c6, from e9f0cde5) with --eco-from. Iteration 3 (top b7ec6228): GPU_FULLCHIP_SIGNOFF_PASS, setup +0.09 ns, hold +0.178 ns (6a98e1be). The --eco-from runs reuse their predecessor ORFS result directory, so the 6_final files of UL 940bd553 / LR e9f0cde5 bound by the superseded iteration-1/2 records were overwritten (the packaged eco-from/completion.json of each block records the predecessor SHA-256 values that no longer match; see the physical-eco-from items). The iteration-1/2 top, STA and context records stay in grading/evidence/student-mini-v1/environment and are not packaged.

GPU gate-level power replay: the partition top netlist declares the six per-memory-port vectors (mem_req_ready_i, mem_req_rw_o, mem_req_valid_o, mem_rsp_error_i, mem_rsp_ready_o, mem_rsp_valid_i) as [1:0] where the RTL declares [0:1]; the replay therefore uses a copy of the top netlist whose only change is those declaration lines (replay_port_order in scripts/run_student_mini_gpu_gate_power.py; asserted and recorded in the power completion). The first GPU power run (HOLD, mem_req_valid_o mismatch from cycle 79 = ports 0/1 swapped) was a harness failure; it is archived in build/student-mini/superseded-20261014/harness-failures/gpu-gate-power-port-order (README there). The packaged run 5d1eaf9e is GPU_GATE_POWER_STAGE_PASS: 30 records, 0 output mismatches.
